headline: Man attacked by tiger in England after entering enclosure at wildlife park

paragraphs.text: , South Yorkshire Police said in a statement. The Yorkshire Ambulance Service said it dispatched two ambulances, an air ambulance and a doctor to attend the scene. The attraction is a purpose-built two-acre reserve for endangered Amur tigers, also known as Siberian tigers.

Visitors to several zoos and wildlife parks around the world have tried to enter tiger enclosures. A woman was caught in 2024 jumping over a fence and taunting a tiger at the Cohanzick Zoo in New Jersey. In 2016, a zookeeper was fatally attacked by a Malayan tiger at a Florida zoo when she entered the enclosure for the tigers' night house, a medical examiner's investigation found.

Several years earlier, in 2012, a man jumped from an area near the monorail in the Bronx Zoo over two fences, including an electrified one, in one bound to get into the tiger enclosure, police said. He was severely injured in what appeared to be a suicide attempt, police said.
